_about: Characters whose portrait PROMPT (the look, i.e. the first sentence of a generated desc) changed after their render shipped. gen-portrait-manifest marks them rendered:false / relook:true so the render queue picks them up. The art agent's ship path removes an id once its new render is in web/portraits/thumb/. Written 2026-10-07 when the look pools went from 18 to 50 lines (Mario: 'we can always use more new faces').
